name: Continuous line as narrative spine

source.description: Three inspected references keep one line alive across scenes (a heartbeat trace that becomes the ground line of every scene, staff lines that become an underline, a swoosh that closes the piece).

technique: One line persists or is redrawn across scene changes and changes role (heartbeat, horizon, path, underline), so a story of many scenes reads as one continuous thought.
purpose: Continuity and structure for multi-scene stories; a visual throughline that can open and close the piece.
visual_behaviour: A line drawn in the first scene stays in the same screen position through cuts while the scenery changes around it, then returns to its first form at the end.
mechanics: Line on a layer above the scenes (or at the same position in each scene) drawn with a pen-led stroke; scene cuts never cross the line's position.

decomposition.timing: Whole piece; bookend draws of 1-2 s.

parameters.name: line role per scene
parameters.description: Which object the line becomes in each scene

failure_modes: The line competes with scene content if it is too heavy
Breaking position continuity at a cut loses the effect

implementation.approach: Draw the spine with Studio.draw.pen on a full-frame SVG above the scenes (or the same path in each scene); scene changes happen around it. Demonstrated in tests/reference-derived/pen-and-bloom; no dedicated runtime API.

priority.note: A composition principle; a reusable composition could follow once two projects use it.

provenance.observed: A heartbeat trace becomes the ground line walked through every life stage and returns flat at the end.
Lines drawn from the accent dot recur as staff lines and as the closing underline.
A swoosh line closes the reel and retracts into a dot.

evidence.notes: Pen line, its dot and a later pen underline carry one thread across three scenes.

licensing_notes: Technique only, learned from user-supplied references (inspiration-only, rights unknown). Never reuse the reference stories or characters.
